title: WWTP — discharge permit
description: The consent conditions, from the contract's `permit:` block, with the signals that evidence them. Generated from contracts/tags.yaml.

panels.title: Ammonia — permit 10 mg/L 30-day mean
panels.description: The permit is a **30-day mean**, and this panel is not one. It is here to show the signal, and the report against the permit is computed below — because a panel of hourly values and a compliance number that is a 30-day mean are two different facts and putting the second next to the first without saying so is how a plant talks itself into a breach.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, mean AS value FROM reading_1h WHERE signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:NH4'   AND bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND bucket <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY time -- nh4_mg_l, hourly tier

panels.title: Suspended solids — permit 30 mg/L
panels.description: Suspended solids against a 30 mg/L permit, hourly tier. The band is the contract's normal band and is *not* the permit: the permit is a limit and the band is where the process usually is, and they are different numbers doing different jobs. The permit computation is in the table below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, mean AS value FROM reading_1h WHERE signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:TSS'   AND bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND bucket <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY time -- tss_mg_l, hourly tier

panels.title: Permit compliance, from the contract
panels.description: The **only** place in this project that computes a compliance number, and it is the `reading_1h` tier on purpose: a 30-day mean over 4.3 million raw rows is a query nobody runs, and over 720 hourly buckets it is one nobody notices. A false number computed quickly is still a false number, so the arithmetic is checked in `tests/test_grafana_dashboards.py` rather than trusted here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH span AS (SELECT now() - interval '30 days' AS since)
SELECT 'ammonia, 30-day mean' AS parameter,
       'mg/L'  AS unit,
       10.0::float AS permit_value,
       'max'  AS direction,
       round(avg(h.mean)::numeric, 3) AS measured,
       round((100 * avg(h.mean) / 10.0)::numeric, 1) AS pct_of_permit,
       avg(h.mean) <= 10.0 AS compliant
FROM reading_1h h, span w
WHERE h.signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:NH4' AND h.bucket >= w.since
HAVING count(*) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'suspended solids, 30-day mean', 'mg/L', 30.0::float, 'max',
       round(avg(h.mean)::numeric, 3),
       round((100 * avg(h.mean) / 30.0)::numeric, 1), avg(h.mean) <= 30.0
FROM reading_1h h, span w
WHERE h.signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:TSS' AND h.bucket >= w.since
HAVING count(*) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pH, minimum', 'pH', 6.0::float, 'min',
       round(min(h.mean)::numeric, 3),
       round((100 * min(h.mean) / 6.0)::numeric, 1), min(h.mean) >= 6.0
FROM reading_1h h, span w
WHERE h.signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:PH' AND h.bucket >= w.since
HAVING count(*) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pH, maximum', 'pH', 9.0::float, 'max',
       round(max(h.mean)::numeric, 3),
       round((100 * max(h.mean) / 9.0)::numeric, 1), max(h.mean) <= 9.0
FROM reading_1h h, span w
WHERE h.signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:PH' AND h.bucket >= w.since
HAVING count(*) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'coliforms, geometric mean', '{MPN}/100mL', 200::float, 'max',
       round(exp(avg(ln(h.mean)))::numeric, 1),
       round((100 * exp(avg(ln(h.mean))) / 200)::numeric, 1),
       exp(avg(ln(h.mean))) <= 200
FROM reading_1h h, span w
WHERE h.signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:DIS-CL-2:BACTI' AND h.bucket >= w.since
  AND h.mean > 0
HAVING count(*) > 0
ORDER BY parameter
